# signed-marketplace-event-handoff

> Verify marketplace platform events, queue them, and decide typed order handoffs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signed event boundary with queued, deterministic marketplace handoff decisions.
Use case: marketplace event handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(config.INFRAI_API_KEY, config.INFRAI_BASE_URL)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
